desc: Improve all of your handgun skills as you switch it up between two hands to one hand, both strong and weak, to reloading with this time and accuracy training drill. Shooter begins in low ready position. On start signal, shooter fires three rounds at top blue target with both hands; moves right to green target and fires two rounds with strong hand; moves down to orange target and fires one round with both hands, performs a reload, then fires two more rounds with both hands; moves left to blue target and fires three rounds; moves down to green target and fires two rounds with weak hand; and finally moves right to blue target and fires three rounds.
